summary: MCPB server.mcp_config.env must bind TESSIE_API_TOKEN from a sensitive user_config.tessie_api_token entry while keeping PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE.
reason: The MCPB contract requires every declared auth env var to be injected through mcp_config.env and a matching user_config key; omitting TESSIE_API_TOKEN fails Validate MCPB manifest contract and leaves Desktop hosts unable to supply the bearer token.
